sources.title: Qwen3 Complete Guide: Every Model from 0.6B to 235B
sources.snippet: Qwen3 is the best open model family for budget local AI. Dense models from 0.6B to 32B, MoE models that punch above their weight, and a /think toggle no one else has.

sources.title: qwen3:4b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Additionally, the small MoE model, Qwen3-30B-A3B, outcompetes QwQ-32B with 10 times of activated parameters, and even a tiny model like Qwen3-4B can rival the performance of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct.

sources.title: ai-hub-models/src/qai_hub_models/models/qwen3_4b/README.md at ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: The Qwen3-4B is a state-of-the-art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics. This is based on the implementation of Qwen3-4B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices.

sources.title: Qwen 3 4B — CanIRun.ai
sources.snippet: The flagship model, Qwen3-235B-A22B, achieves competitive results in benchmark evaluations of coding, math, general capabilities, etc., when compared to other top-tier models such as DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3, and Gemini-2.5-Pro.
